appearance: Tall, lean and ramrod-straight, silver-grey hair combed severely back; tailcoat and white gloves. His left hand always grips a ring of brass keys, and there is a fleck of white lime on his right trouser cuff.
summary: The old butler of Greyoak House, forty years in the service of the Greywoods. A man of few words and fiercely loyal, he will not be drawn on where his master has gone.
